title: Before handing back the keys
phrase: I hand back the keys next week. I moved in on 12 March 2024. Which parts of the flat have no move-in photo?
final: You're welcome. Good luck with your move! If you need anything else, feel free to ask.

steps.text: I hand back the keys next week. I moved in on 12 March 2024. Which parts of the flat have no move-in photo?

steps.instruction: Search the photo library for images (not videos and not screenshots) whose capture time falls inside the move-in window (from 2024-02-27 to 2024-04-11). If the library search offers scene or object filters, use them to keep only photos of the inside of a home (rooms, walls, floors, kitchen, bathroom, fixtures) and say how many were left out; do not run the vision model in this step. Use the location filter only if the person gave an address or city. For every photo return its photo identifier and file path as the library gives them, and its capture time read from the photo metadata. List photos with no capture time separately as undated. Change nothing. If there are no photos, return an empty list and say so plainly.

data.scene_filter: scene recognition is not available in this emulator; every photo in the window is returned

steps.message: I found 4 photos from the move-in window, and 0 photos were left out.

steps.instruction: For each photo returned by the search step (at most 40 per window, as selected above), run the vision model on that single image with this prompt: Which part of a rented home does this photo show? Answer on the first line with exactly one label for the main subject, from this list: kitchen-oven, kitchen-counter, kitchen-sink, fridge, bathroom-tub, bathroom-sink, toilet, living-room-wall, living-room-carpet, bedroom-wall, bedroom-carpet, window, front-door, not-a-spot, unclear. Use unclear when the photo is too dark or too blurry to tell. On the second line list any other labels from the same list that are also clearly visible, separated by commas, or write none. On the third line write one sentence about visible dirt, stains, marks or damage, or write none visible. Return the photo identifier, the path, the capture time from the search step, the main label, the other visible labels and the sentence for every photo. Do not guess a label for a photo you cannot read.
